desc: Implement minOperations: integer-based d(x), prefix F(n) via threshold counting over powers of 4, per-query max(d(r), ceil(S/2)), sum and return.
Validate against provided examples and a brute-force checker on small ranges; report pass/fail and any off-by-one.
Confirm whether max(d(r), ceil(S/2)) simplifies to ceil(S/2) for all l<r; keep the safe max form.
Optimize/verify performance for 1e5 queries with r up to 1e9 (each query O(log_4 r) == ~15 iterations, precomputed powers of 4).
